sources.quote: IAB Canada puts Canadian digital advertising up 16 percent to $21.1 billion in 2025, search still the largest category
sources.title: Canada’s Digital Advertising Market Shows Strong Growth in 2025
sources.evidence: In 2025, Canada's digital advertising market grew 16% year-over-year to reach $21.1 billion, with growth led by established performance channels as well as newer areas of investment. Search remained the largest category, while social media continued to hold its position as the second-largest channel.

sources.quote: users clicked an organic result on 8 percent of searches carrying an AI summary against 15 percent without one
sources.title: Google users are less likely to click on links when an AI summary appears in the results
sources.evidence: Users who landed on a Google search page with an AI summary clicked on a search result 8% of the time. In contrast, those who did not encounter an AI summary clicked on a search result 15% of the time. The total dataset used in this analysis contains 68,879 unique Google searches from 900 U.S. adults during March 2025; people who encountered the summaries very rarely clicked on the sources cited.

sources.quote: Search campaigns running campaign level broad match or automatically created assets were upgraded to AI Max through September 2026, and Dynamic Search Ads follow in February 2027
sources.title: Google’s Dynamic Search Ads are upgrading to AI Max
sources.evidence: Google is extending the timeline for Dynamic Search Ads sunset and auto-upgrade, which will begin in February 2027, in response to advertiser feedback requesting more time to complete the transition from DSA to AI Max. Campaigns using Automatically Created Assets (ACA) and campaign-level broad match setting will continue to be auto-upgraded starting in September 2026, with all upgrades for eligible campaigns expected to conclude by the end of September.

sources.quote: campaign negatives hold 10,000 entries, and channel reporting splits the network out
sources.title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns - Google Ads Help
sources.evidence: You can apply a maximum of 10,000 negative keywords to a Performance Max campaign, and negative keywords apply to Search and Shopping inventory. The limit on campaign-level negative keywords was raised from 100 to 10,000 per Performance Max campaign; Performance Max negative keywords are applicable to Search and Shopping inventory only.

sources.quote: On 20 October 2025 Google folded Google Guaranteed, Google Screened and License Verified into one Google Verified badge
sources.title: About Google Verified badge - Local Services Help
sources.evidence: Effective October 20, 2025, Local Services Ads will be simplifying badging by launching a single, more cohesive Google Verified badge for all advertisers. Google will discontinue all existing Local Services Ads badges, including Google Guaranteed, Google Screened, and License Verified by Google, effective October 20, 2025. As part of this change, Google will be discontinuing the Money Back Guarantee associated with the Google Guarantee badge.

sources.quote: needs advanced consent mode, a sufficient consent rate and roughly 700 ad clicks over seven days per country and domain pair
sources.title: About consent mode modeling - Google Ads Help
sources.evidence: You have a daily ad click threshold of 700 ad clicks over a 7 day period, per country and domain grouping. Once the above criteria are met, our models enter training periods. When you implement consent mode in its advanced version, Google tags load when a user opens the website or app; this implementation enables improved modeling compared to the basic one as it provides an advertiser-specific model.

sources.quote: Since 15 June 2026 the ad_storage signal alone controls what GA4 shares with linked Ads accounts
sources.title: Updates to Google Analytics Data Controls - Analytics Help
sources.evidence: Starting June 15, 2026, Google Analytics will transition to using Consent Mode (within Google Ads) as the single control for data. Users' privacy selections, managed via Ads Consent Mode settings, will exclusively govern how data is collected and used; for linked properties, Google Ads settings will exclusively control Google Ads data (including data shared by Google Analytics). Consent Mode ad_storage controls the usage of Google Ads cookies and IDs from the Google Analytics tag in Google Ads.
